text:
sasha: Hey team — Acme Health wants a short hosted demo next Tue (30m). They expect bursty traffic: ~120 QPS for 10m during the demo and 5–10 QPS baseline. Can we safely offer a temporary quota bump?
jordan: Quick Q — is that 120 rps of short generation calls or long streaming chat sessions?
sasha: Mostly short generative calls (avg 120 tokens, single prompt -> single response). There will be 3 concurrent connections from their demo rig.
mike: Okay. On hosted we can open a scoped ephemeral key with a temporary rate window. We typically do: scoped_key + qps_cap + ip allowlist + expiry.
nana-sales: (pinging for cost estimate) rough numbers so I can confirm with Acme.
mike: Costwise, add a 2x safety margin for burst; if they hit 120 QPS * 600s * ~120 tokens ≈ 8.6M tokens. If billed per token, that is the upper bound. I'll send a quick calc after confirming token billing.
jordan: Operational constraints: hosted rate increases are fine for short demos but we need a rollback and monitoring hook. I can add a dashboard tile and an alert for 10% error increase.
sasha: Can you also enable a fallback to a lower-cost quantized variant if kernel capacity saturates? We want graceful degradation, not hard throttles.
mike: We can set routing policy: primary model = redwood/gpt-ml-large, fallback = redwood/gpt-ml-large-quantized. If primary latency > 750ms for N consecutive windows, route new requests to fallback. That avoids 429 storms.
ops-bot: Note: Scoped keys expire and cannot be extended after issuance by non-admins. Requestor must specify expiry at creation.
jordan: For the scoped key we need: origin IPs (demo laptop IPs), time window (UTC), qps cap, token limit, and contact for urgent revoke.
sasha: I'll confirm IPs and demo window: Tue 2026-06-02 15:00–15:40 UTC, IPs: 198.51.100.23 and 198.51.100.24. Contact: tim@acme.com and me (sasha@redwood).
mike: Cool. Proposed scoped key policy: qps: 140 (10% buffer), burst window 10s, concurrency 6, expires 2026-06-02T16:00:00Z, rate-limited by token-based quota of 10M tokens.
nana-sales: Can you do 140 QPS? That's a bit higher than their ask but safe. Also need a short note I can send to procurement about security controls.
jordan: Security blurb: scoped keys are single-purpose, IP restricted, short TTL, no account-level access. All requests are logged with key fingerprint; logs are retained for 30 days by default (can extend on enterprise). Keys can be rotated and revoked immediately.
sasha: Also include that data is not used for training and is separated for POC; we have option for dedicated pools if they need isolation.
mike: Implementation steps for ops: 1) create scoped key via admin console with provided IPs and TTL 2) create dashboard panel for key usage and errors 3) apply routing policy with fallback model 4) pre-warm KV cache for typical prompts (we can upload a small seed set) 5) stand-by engineer for demo.
jordan: Pre-warm note: pre-warming reduces first-request latency for big models. Send a small set of 10 canonical prompts to mike by EOD.
ops-bot: Action created: scoped_key-request-2111112222 by sasha. Assigned to mike. SLA target: same-day.
mike: I'll take it. Quick curl example for the scoped key (for Acme devs):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-ml-large","input":"Summarize this record...","max_tokens":150}'
```
sasha: Great. One more ask from security: can we disable streaming for that key (they want full-response only)?
mike: Yes, set allow_streaming=false on the key. I'll include that.
nana-sales: Perfect — send me the scoped key policy and the estimated worst-case bill so procurement can sign off.
jordan: Monitoring plan: create a Grafana alert on 5m p95 latency > 1s and error rate > 1%. If triggered, automatic rollback to fallback model, and page on-call.
sasha: Thanks — timeline: please provision by Mon EOD so we can dry-run Tue 14:30 UTC.
mike: Will do. I'll create the key and share the ephemeral token in the secure channel once ready.
ops-bot: Scoped key provisioned: sk_demo_7a9f... (token redacted). Shared to #sales-secure.
nana-sales: Got it. Sending to Acme now with the cost note.
sasha: 👍 Closing loop — stand-by engineer for Tue is mike. If anything changes, @sasha will update this thread.
